Organic Measures.Pest Control: Regular pruning and destruction of mealybug or hopper colonies.
Organic Measures.Natural Sprays: Applying neem oil (3%) to remove honeydew and eliminate fungi.
Organic Measures.Biological Agents: Release Cryptolaemus montrouzieri (mealybug destroyer beetle) to control pests.
Organic Measures.Sanitation: Keep orchards clean; remove heavily infested twigs if found.
Organic Measures.Irrigation Balance: Avoid excessive moisture that promotes pest multiplication.

Chemical Measures.Insecticides: For hoppers and mealybugs, spray dimethoate (0.05%) or imidacloprid (0.005%).
Chemical Measures.Fungicides: Apply copper oxychloride (0.3%) or carbendazim (0.1%) to reduce fungal deposits.
Chemical Measures.Timing: Apply before flowering and post-harvest periods for maximum efficiency.

Organic Measures.Manual Collection: Handpick and destroy adult weevils early in the season.
Organic Measures.Neem-Based Repellents: Apply or spray neem seed kernel extract (5%) during pre-monsoon months.
Organic Measures.Traps: Use light or pheromone traps to monitor adult activity.
Organic Measures.Cultural Practices: Remove fallen leaves to eliminate pests in pupal stages.

Chemical Measures.Contact Insecticides: Spray quinalphos (0.05%) or chlorpyrifos (0.04%) to reduce adult population.
Chemical Measures.Soil Drench: Apply imidacloprid (0.3 ml/L) near tree basins to kill larvae.
Chemical Measures.Spray Schedule: Apply during adult emergence and repeat after 15–20 days if infestation persists.

Organic Measures.Pruning: Remove and burn affected shoots to disrupt life cycles.
Organic Measures.Soil Management: Deep plough after harvest to expose pupae to sunlight.
Organic Measures.Neem Oil: Apply neem oil (3%) to reduce egg laying.
Organic Measures.Intercropping: Plant repellent species like marigold to reduce adult migration.

Chemical Measures.Systemic Insecticides: Use dimethoate (0.05%) or fipronil (0.005%) at bud initiation stage.
Chemical Measures.Timing: Two sprays recommended — one at new leaf flush and another after 15 days.
